title: The inhomogeneous Total Variation Flow with $L^1$-data
summary: This paper is devoted to the study of the Dirichlet problem for the parabolic equation driven by the $1$--Laplacian operator under minimal integrability assumptions. Specifically, we consider \begin{equation*} u'-\Div(Du/|D u|)=f\qquad\text{ in } (0,+\infty)\timesΩ\,, \end{equation*} where $Ω\subset\R^N$ is a bounded open set with Lipschitz boundary, $u_0\in L^1(Ω)$ is the initial datum, and $f\in L_{loc}^1(0,+\infty; L^1(Ω))$ is the source term.
